title: Server settings
subtitle: The full Technitium DNS Server configuration — {count} options
applyToNodeHelp: Leave blank to change this machine only; pick a node to forward the change through the cluster.
restartHint: Options carrying this flag need a DNS service restart before they take effect.
dangerHint: A wrong change here can lock you out of the console. Proceed with care.
clusterScopeWarning: “All cluster nodes” is selected: only cluster-wide settings are submitted. Machine-specific ones (listeners, cache, logging) are ignored.
validationFailed: Some fields failed validation — fix them before saving
outOfScope: This panel has nothing to submit for the selected node scope

general.dnsServerDomainHelp: Used to build the hostnames in automatically generated SOA and NS records.
general.ipv6ModeHelp: Disabled turns IPv6 off completely; Preferred favors IPv6 egress.
general.enableUdpSocketPoolHelp: Reusing ports cuts resolution latency under heavy load, but makes cache poisoning easier.
general.socketPoolExcludedPortsHelp: One port number per line. The pool never claims these ports.
general.udpPayloadSizeHelp: The largest datagram this server advertises it can receive over EDNS0. Default 1232.
general.dnssecValidationHelp: Verifies signatures on recursively resolved answers.

listeners.dnsServerLocalEndPointsHelp: One `IP:port` per line, for example 0.0.0.0:53 or [::]:53.
listeners.sourceAddressHelp: On a multi-homed host these limit the source address used for upstream packets. Leave blank to let the system choose.

zoneDefaults.title: Defaults for new zones
zoneDefaults.defaultResponsiblePersonHelp: Written to the RNAME field of the SOA record. Leave blank to derive it from the server domain.
zoneDefaults.useSoaSerialDateScheme: Use the date-based SOA serial scheme
zoneDefaults.useSoaSerialDateSchemeHelp: SOA serials then follow the yyyyMMddnn format.
zoneDefaults.networkHelp: One CIDR range per line, for example 10.0.0.0/8. Leave blank for no restriction.

webService.title: Web console and HTTP API
webService.dangerBanner: Changing the listen address or port can leave you unable to reach this console at its current address.
webService.webServiceLocalAddressesHelp: One IP per line. [::] means every address.
webService.webServiceUseSelfSignedTlsHelp: The server generates one automatically when no certificate path is set.
webService.webServiceReverseProxyHelp: Only requests from these ranges may carry X-Real-IP and similar headers.
webService.webServiceRealIpHeaderHelp: Defaults to X-Real-IP. Adjust it when the console sits behind Nginx or Caddy.
webService.webServiceCspFrameAncestorsHelp: Controls which sites may embed this console in an iframe. Denied by default.

dnsOverX.title: Encrypted DNS transport
dnsOverX.hint: Offer clients encrypted query endpoints over DoH, DoT and DoQ. TLS-based transports need a certificate.
dnsOverX.enableDnsOverHttpHelpRedirect: Redirect the HTTP root path to the help page
dnsOverX.enableDnsOverHttpUnixSocket: Serve DoH over a Unix socket
dnsOverX.enableDnsOverHttpsUnixSocket: Serve DoH(S) over a Unix socket
dnsOverX.dnsReverseProxyNetworkACLHelp: One CIDR range per line. Only these sources may carry the real IP header.
dnsOverX.enableEDnsClientSubnetSourceAddress: Enable the EDNS Client Subnet source address

recursion.title: Recursion and forwarders
recursion.recursionHelp: Controls which clients may ask this server to resolve recursively.
recursion.recursionNetworkACLHelp: Applies only when the policy is “Use the specified network ACL”.
recursion.forwardersHelp: One IP, host:port or https:// DoH address per line, tried in order.
recursion.concurrentForwardingHelp: Asks several forwarders at once and takes the fastest reply, at the cost of doubled traffic.
recursion.randomizeNameHelp: Shuffles label casing to make cache poisoning harder.
recursion.qnameMinimizationHelp: Reveals only the name levels an upstream needs, which improves privacy.
recursion.locallyServedDnsZonesHelp: Answer reserved zones such as localhost and private reverse lookups directly from this server.

proxy.title: Upstream proxy
proxy.hint: The proxy this server uses to reach forwarders, the app store and block lists.
proxy.proxyBypassHelp: One CIDR range or domain per line. These targets are reached directly.
proxy.testHelp: Reaches the update-check endpoint through the proxy. It exercises the saved proxy configuration, so unsaved edits are not used.
proxy.requiresAddress: An address and port are required when a proxy is enabled

blocking.title: Domain blocking
blocking.enableBlockingHelp: When off, neither the blocked list nor any block list takes effect.
blocking.allowTxtBlockingReportHelp: Clients can query _blocked.<domain> as TXT to learn which rule blocked a name.
blocking.blockingTypeHelp: AnyAddress returns 0.0.0.0, NxDomain returns a non-existent name, CustomAddress returns the addresses you define.
blocking.customBlockingAddressesHelp: One IP per line. Used only when the blocking type is CustomAddress.
blocking.blockingBypassListHelp: One domain per line. These are let through even when a rule matches.
blocking.blockListUrlsHelp: One URL per line. The server downloads these periodically and merges them into the blocked list.
blocking.temporaryDisableHelp: Pauses all blocking for the given number of minutes, then resumes automatically.

cache.title: Cache
cache.saveCacheHelp: Writes the cache to disk so nothing has to be resolved again after a service restart.
cache.cacheMaximumEntriesHelp: Set 0 for no limit, and keep an eye on memory usage.
cache.prefetchHelp: Frequently requested names are refreshed before their remaining TTL drops below the threshold, which lowers the latency users see.
cache.serveStaleHelp: When the upstream is unreachable, return expired cache first and refresh it in the background.

rateLimit.title: Query rate limiting
rateLimit.hint: Caps queries per minute by source address prefix to blunt DNS amplification and abuse.
rateLimit.rulesHelp: One `prefix length/UDP limit/TCP limit` per line, for example 32/600/600.
rateLimit.empty: No rate limit rules configured yet
rateLimit.qpmLimitUdpTruncationHelp: A high truncation rate usually means spoofed source addresses. Once the threshold is reached, queries are dropped.
rateLimit.qpmLimitBypassListHelp: One domain or network range per line. These are exempt from rate limiting.

edns.title: EDNS and client subnet
edns.eDnsClientSubnetHelp: Reveals the client's network range to upstreams in exchange for closer CDN answers, at the cost of privacy.
edns.overrideHelp: Leave blank to use the real client address. Set a value and every query advertises it as the subnet.

logging.title: Logging and statistics
logging.ignoreResolverLogsHelp: Resolver detail is very verbose. Keep it on only while troubleshooting recursion.
logging.logQueriesHelp: Needs the query logging app installed before entries reach the database.
logging.noStackTrace: Omit stack traces from error responses
logging.useLocalTimeHelp: UTC is used when this is off.
logging.enableInMemoryStatsHelp: The dashboard charts depend on this. Once off, statistics stop accumulating.

tsig.title: TSIG keys
tsig.hint: Used to HMAC-sign zone transfers and dynamic updates.
tsig.deleteConfirm: Delete the TSIG key {name}? Zone transfers using it fail immediately.
tsig.applyOnSave: The change reaches the server only after you save.
tsig.invalidBase64: The shared secret must be a valid Base64 string

updates.title: Updates
updates.upToDate: You are on the latest version, {version}

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.subtitle: Export the server's full configuration, or restore it from a backup file

sectionHints.logs: Log files can be large and will noticeably slow the backup down.
sectionHints.deleteExistingFiles: Use with care: the restore clears the destination first.

backup.backupHint: Produces a .tzsp archive containing everything you selected.
backup.restoreHint: Restoring overwrites the matching configuration on the server and cannot be undone. Download a current backup first.
backup.restoreFileDrop: Drop a .tzsp file here, or click to choose one
backup.restoreSuccess: Configuration restored — the server is applying the new settings
backup.restoreConfirm: Overwrite the current configuration with this backup file? This cannot be undone.
backup.restoreWarning: Restoring web console settings can change the listen port and drop your current session.

advanced.title: Advanced options
advanced.warning: These settings change the server's network behavior directly. Make sure you understand the consequences before editing them.
advanced.rawJsonHint: The complete configuration object as returned by the server, for comparison and troubleshooting.
